stories.title: New report details airstrike on Iranian school
stories.summary: NPR's Sacha Pfeiffer speaks with Jeremy Scahill of Drop Site News, which has issued an extensive new report on the U.S. airstrikes on a school in southern Iran.

stories.title: Candidates for Minnesota governor share 'sisterhood' as cancer survivors
stories.summary: The rival candidates for governor of Minnesota are both breast cancer survivors, who've talked to each other about it - and spoke to a reporter about how that's shaped their lives and policies.

stories.title: With parallel parking turning competitive, one producer gets a lesson
stories.summary: Philadelphia held a parallel parking competition, and crowned Mario Zucca the winner after three rounds of challenges.

stories.title: NPR spoke to Cuban men now stuck in limbo in Central African Republic
stories.summary: Thousands of people have been sent to countries they have no ties to and in some cases have never even heard of as part of the Trump administration's drive toward mass deportations.

stories.title: 'The Third Eye' presents an unfiltered view of the Beatles' early years
stories.summary: NPR's Ailsa Chang talks with Olivia Harrison about the new book The Third Eye, a collection of photographs by her late husband, George Harrison of the Beatles.

stories.title: There's a contraception shortage in Tanzania due to a cut in U.S. family planning aid
stories.summary: The U.S. supplied the majority of Tanzania's birth control until it was abruptly cut off in 2025. It's unclear how the country will fill the gaps.
